title: A New Tax System (Family Assistance) Act 1999
compilation_note: The Register gives this version no compilation number. Its cover: 'This compilation was prepared on 1 July 2006 taking into account amendments up to Act No. 82 of 2006'.
register_comment: This compilation is affected by a retrospective amendment, please see Family Assistance and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2012 [Act No. 49 of 2012], for details.

word_download.note: legacy binary .DOC, so the text was taken from the EPUB of the same document, as the workbench fetcher does

converter:
epub_text() of the workbench's harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py with one change: the paragraphs inside table cells are kept. epub_text() matches a that holds

paragraphs, skips it as a container and resumes after it, so every such cell's text is lost -- in this compilation all of the rate tables (Schedule 1 cll 2, 7, 14, 30; Schedule 4 cll 2, 3). Its output is a line-for-line subsequence of this text (checked 2026-10-22); 1,204 more lines are table cells. Script: conv_epub_tables.py in the depositing session's scratchpad.
note: Historical compilation C2006C00402, in force from 1 July 2006 to 27 September 2006; requested from the Register as the version in force on 30 August 2006 (Jake's birth, scenario event k002). Deposited beside the current text C2004A00490.txt; the file name carries the date the compilation came into force. It has the maternity payment provisions (ss 36-38, 66; Schedule 4 item 17A) that were later repealed. As served it reads s 3(7) 'CPC rate' with a 'pension supplement' limb (Module BA of Pension Rate Calculator A), a concept from after 2006; the Register's comment about a retrospective amendment by Act No. 49 of 2012 may explain it. Not encoded. The 33 images in the EPUB (formulas, and the cover) are not in the text; C2004A00490.2006-07-01.formulas.md transcribes three and lists the rest.
